pages.title: Alternate Styles
pages.text: Two optional looks for every machine, item and screen, with nothing extra to download:$(br2)$(l)Blueprint Mode$(): blueprint blues and white line-work.$(br2)$(l)Dark Mode$(): matte near-black, with the cyan glow kept loud.$(br2)Both change the look, never the information.

pages.title: How to Enable
pages.text: 1. Open $(l)Options -> Resource Packs$().$(br)2. Find $(l)MC3DPrint: Blueprint Mode$() or $(l)Dark Mode$().$(br)3. Click the $(l)arrow$() to move it to the Selected side.$(br)4. Click $(l)Done$().$(br2)Move it back to return to the default art. Both ship as standalone zips too.
